querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      fundmanager_id,
                                      trade_date,
                                      fmindex_type,
                                      fmindex_point,
                                      totreturn_ytd,
                                      ranking_ytd,
                                      totreturn_1w,
                                      ranking_1w,
                                      totreturn_1m,
                                      ranking_1m,
                                      totreturn_3m,
                                      ranking_3m,
                                      totreturn_6m,
                                      ranking_6m,
                                      totreturn_1y,
                                      ranking_1y,
                                      totreturn_2y,
                                      ranking_2y,
                                      totreturn_3y,
                                      ranking_3y,
                                      totreturn_5y,
                                      ranking_5y,
                                      totreturn_10y,
                                      ranking_10y,
                                      totreturn_es,
                                      annreturnes,
                                      ranking_es,
                                      worsttotreturn_6m,
                                      besttotreturn_6m,
                                      sucbasereturn_ytd,
                                      sucbasereturn_1w,
                                      sucbasereturn_1m,
                                      sucbasereturn_3m,
                                      sucbasereturn_6m,
                                      sucbasereturn_1y,
                                      sucbasereturn_2y,
                                      sucbasereturn_3y,
                                      sucbasereturn_5y,
                                      sucbasereturn_10y,
                                      sucbasereturn_es,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_chinamfmperformance.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.chinamfmperformance WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
